test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row facing north. Only three people are sitting to the right of A. Only one person is sitting between A and C. E is sitting second to the extreme left end of the row. B is not the immediate neighbour of A. F is sitting to the immediate left of B. F is sitting to the immediate right of A. Who is sitting at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row facing north.

1. Only three people are sitting to the right of A.

2. Only one person is sitting between A and C.

3. E is sitting second to the extreme left end of the row.

4. B is not the immediate neighbour of A.

5. F is sitting to the immediate left of B.

6. F is sitting to the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06ad38702972e4f168d922e3bc8c009955ae742de740e390fe0f9db7a572ee9a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/337f6c234d75fcf853157094ddd459914e2715e29690f8d403c357c526b079fb.png] 

C sitting at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
